adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `PollFeed` falls back from `i.link` to `i.id` and that `TopicEmbed.import` will drop non-HTTP/blank URLs (`return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`). However, the core claim that “SimpleRSS stores the RSS 2.0 identifier under `:guid` not `:id`, so `i.id` is always nil for RSS 2.0 items” depends on SimpleRSS’s external API/behavior, which is not verifiable from this diff alone. The diff itself doesn’t demonstrate that `i.id` never works for RSS 2.0.
